producer: src/transform/build_daily_facts.py (full build) · src/agentic/refresh_prices.py (daily) · repairs: repair_be_series_gaps.py (2026-08-28 for 2025+, 2026-09-27 for 2015+), build_price_only_ca_factors.py --apply (2026-09-27)
source: NSE official bhavcopies (data/raw/nse_full_history_official): old format cm*bhav.csv.zip to 2019, sec_bhavdata_full csv 2020+
series_scope: EQ + BE + BZ (trade-for-trade) for every symbol that ever traded EQ. Symbols that only ever traded BE/BZ are NOT in the panel (2015-16 coverage 98-99.5% of raw EQ/BE/BZ symbols; 2017+ >= 99.57%; full eval logs/evals/panel_coverage_2026-09-23.json).

adjustment.price_adjustment_factor_to_present: multiplier applied to raw prices: (1 / split-bonus share factor) x price-only factor (demerger, scheme, rights at TERP, special dividend, consolidation); see data/corporate_actions_full_history/normalized/price_only_ca_factors.parquet
adjustment.share_adjustment_factor_to_present: split/bonus share multiplier applied to quantities
adjustment.raw_columns: raw_* hold the as-traded values where an adjustment was applied; NaN where no adjustment ever applied (then raw == adjusted)
adjustment.price_levels: for LEVEL filters use close / price_adjustment_factor_to_present (research_panel.raw_price), never the adjusted close

units.delivery_pct: fraction 0-1 (BE/BZ imputed 1.0: trade-for-trade is compulsory delivery)

known_limitations: rolling features (sma/ema/rsi/avg_traded_value/return_20d) roll over ROWS; with BE/BZ now present, remaining gaps are real suspensions
corporate actions missing from the CA store stay unadjusted (e.g. CROMPGREAV demerger 2016-03-15 -71.7%)
